question_vi: Khi nào cần viết Native Module thay vì tìm package có sẵn?
question_en: When should you write a native module instead of using an existing package?
answer_vi:
Quy tắc: **luôn ưu tiên npm package** trước. Lý do: lib có sẵn được test trên nhiều device, có CI cross-platform, được community fix bug. Tự viết = bạn own toàn bộ maintenance.

**Khi cần viết native module:**

1. **Feature platform mới chưa có lib:** vd iOS Live Activity (App Intents), Android Predictive Back gesture, Apple Watch companion. Lib mất 6–12 tháng để theo kịp.

2. **Wrap SDK third-party native:** Stripe, Firebase Performance, Sentry, AdMob, Branch.io. Đa số có official RN wrapper, nhưng SDK ngách (vendor riêng, banking SDK) thì phải tự wrap.

3. **Performance critical:** image processing real-time, video filter, ML inference, audio DSP. Tính toán nặng JS không kham, native (Metal/Vulkan/Core ML) cần.

4. **Đụng platform-specific permission/hardware:** Bluetooth Low Energy custom protocol, NFC ghi/đọc tag riêng, USB serial, secure element.

5. **Existing native code legacy:** team cũ có codebase Swift/Kotlin lớn → wrap thành module cho đỡ rewrite.

**Trước khi commit viết:**
- Search npm + GitHub + RN directory ([reactnative.directory](https://reactnative.directory)).
- Search Expo Modules — nhiều case Expo đã expose API platform mới.
- Issue trong lib hiện có thường được fix trong vài tuần — cân nhắc wait/contribute thay vì fork.

**Build vs buy reality check:** native module mất 1–2 tuần viết + maintain dài hạn. Lib có sẵn $0 + community support. Chỉ tự viết khi không thể tránh
answer_en:
Rule: **always prefer the npm package first.** Reason: existing libraries are tested across many devices, have cross-platform CI, and get bugs fixed by the community. Rolling your own means you own the maintenance.

**When to write a native module:**

1. **A brand-new platform feature with no library yet:** iOS Live Activity (App Intents), Android Predictive Back gesture, Apple Watch companion. Libraries lag 6–12 months.

2. **Wrapping a third-party native SDK:** Stripe, Firebase Performance, Sentry, AdMob, Branch.io. Most have official RN wrappers, but niche SDKs (vendor-specific, banking) need a hand-rolled wrapper.

3. **Performance-critical work:** real-time image processing, video filtering, ML inference, audio DSP. JS cannot keep up; native (Metal/Vulkan/Core ML) is required.

4. **Platform-specific permissions/hardware:** Bluetooth Low Energy with a custom protocol, NFC read/write of proprietary tags, USB serial, secure elements.

5. **Legacy native code:** an existing Swift/Kotlin codebase you want to wrap so you do not rewrite it.

**Before committing to write one:**
- Search npm + GitHub + the RN directory ([reactnative.directory](https://reactnative.directory)).
- Search Expo Modules — Expo often already exposes new platform APIs.
- Issues in existing libraries are typically fixed in weeks — consider waiting or contributing instead of forking.

**Build vs buy reality check:** a native module costs 1–2 weeks to write plus long-term maintenance. An existing library costs $0 plus community support. Only roll your own when there is no alternative
